latvia.description: The National Armed Forces has issued a warning covering Kraslava municipality regarding a potential threat to airspace. A cell broadcast alert was sent to residents of this municipality. The warning that had been issued ended shortly before midnight.

latvia.title: Most household energy consumption goes to heating in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau survey on energy consumption in households, published on September 21, 83.9 % of the energy resources consumed in households in 2025 were used for space and water heating.

latvia.title: National Alliance kicks out violence apologist Dalbiņš
latvia.description: The Executive Committee of the National Alliance (NA) has decided to expel Valts Dalbiņš, a candidate for a seat in the 15th Saeima, from the party, as he has, in posts on social media, justified violence against women and levelled prejudiced accusations against them.

latvia.title: Temporary bridge to be installed during Vanšu Bridge repairs in Rīga
latvia.description: A temporary bridge is to be erected whilst the Vanšu Bridge is being rebuilt, the Mayor of Riga, Viesturs Kleinbergs (Progressives), has stated on September 21.

latvia.title: Less than 1% turnout in Latvia for Russia's so-called elections
latvia.description: According to the State Police, 290 Russian citizens in Rīga took part in the Russian "elections", representing just 0.8 per cent of all Russian citizens eligible to vote in Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian bank profits down 2.9% in first half of 2026
latvia.description: The Latvian banking sector posted a profit of 205.301 million euros in the first half of this year, which is 2.9 per cent less than in the corresponding period of 2025, according to data published by the Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) on September 21.

latvia.title: Hint of summer might still come next week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected frequently in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: More details emerge in big illegal cigarette case in Latvia
latvia.description: Almost two years ago, the police uncovered an illegal cigarette distribution network; some of those involved are now in the dock, whilst others are still awaiting trial. The initial investigation has given rise to several parallel cases, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on September 21.

latvia.title: Buzzing honey yields this year in Latvia
latvia.description: For the fourteenth year running, the Latvian Beekeepers’ Association (LBB) has been organising the ‘Honey Day at the Apiary’ event, with the aim of promoting honey and other bee products to the public. Throughout the month, around 30 apiaries across all regions opened their doors to the public, TV Kurzeme reported on September 20.

latvia.title: 'Catch some flavour' in Kuldīga, Latvia this week
latvia.description: In Kuldīga, the gastronomic event “Catch the Flavour!” is extending into the autumn with beloved seasonal dishes made mainly of spuds. Overall, it has been a busy summer for restaurateurs, and there is still a steady flow of visitors in September, Latvian Radio reported on September 21.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 20th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rain and thunder across Latvia on Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected across Latvia on Monday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Poland international volleyball
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball championships.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Pēteris Vasks sacred music concert
latvia.description: The closing concert of the 29th International Sacred Music Festival featured a special concert of music by this year’s jubilee composer Pēteris Vasks, who is 80 years old.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards stop more illegal crossers
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 17, in Krāslava Municipality, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Kulbergs and Braže meet U.S. envoy to Belarus
latvia.description: On Thursday, 17th September 2026, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, met with the US Special Envoy to Belarus, John Coale.

latvia.title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Harvest, Old Town, Mushrooms
latvia.description: You would think the festival season is coming to a close, but that is far from the truth. Here are just a few of what you can attend this weekend.

latvia.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period
latvia.description: In a significant development on September 17th, it was announced that extra NATO jets will be coming to Latvia "to reinforce Latvian airspace protection during elections."

latvia.title: Set of stamps to commemorate Latvian basketball star Uļjana Semjonova
latvia.description: In honour of one of Latvia’s greatest ever sportswomen, the world basketball legend Uļjana Semjonova, the state-owned company “Latvijas Pasts” will issue a block of stamps dedicated to her.

latvia.title: Hockey star and Trump family friend added to Latvia's entry blacklist
latvia.description: The Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, has decided to include Russian ice hockey superstar Alexander Ovechkin on Latvia's list of personae non gratae, a Foreign Ministry announcement said on September 17th.

latvia.title: Roadworks continue across Latvia
latvia.description: Construction work is continuing on 53 sections of the national road network, according to a release by Latvian State Roads on September 18.

latvia.title: Latvia to buy Czech artillery system instead of original Swedish option
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 15, the Cabinet of Ministers made a decision to purchase "Morana" 155 mm wheeled artillery systems from the Czech manufacturer Excalibur Army for the needs of the National Armed Forces instead of the Swedish "Archer" systems it originally said it would buy.

latvia.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
latvia.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Friday afternoon will be rainy in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that a new band of precipitation will reach Latvia from the west on Friday afternoon.

latvia.title: Ryanair to expand in Latvia, if government helps
latvia.description: The Irish low-cost airline Ryanair is set to increase its flight schedule in Rīga by around 6 per cent during the coming winter season, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Fees to be hiked on Russian grain transit, total ban to be considered
latvia.description: The Saeima Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee on Thursday considered amendments to the law in two readings, which provide for increasing fees for grain transit transportation from Russia until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Criminal case launched regarding drunk driving welfare minister in Latvia
latvia.description: The Prosecutor’s Office has received the criminal case against Reinis Uzulnieks, the former Minister for Welfare, who was driving under the influence of alcohol, the LETA news agency reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Streaming platforms will be asked to support Latvian film production
latvia.description: It is planned that in future the major streaming platforms will have to invest money in the development of Latvian cinema every year according to law changes supported by the Saeima on September 17th.

latvia.title: Saeima moves towards full Russian food ban
latvia.description: A ban on importing products originating in Russia and Belarus will in future apply not only to agricultural goods and animal feed, but also to food products, according to amendments to the Agriculture and Rural Development Law, which were supported by the Saeima on Thursday, September 10. However, it should be noted that a final reading of the legislation is still required before coming into force.

latvia.title: Liepāja Concert Hall to be headed by Kate Erharde
latvia.description: Following the conclusion of the open competition for the position of board member at SIA “Lielais dzintars”, Kate Erharde – an industry professional with experience in the Latvian and international cultural scene – will become the new director of the concert hall.

latvia.title: Latvia's Euro volleyball hopes remain alive
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball cjhampionships.

latvia.title: U.S. expert: Baltic states have no need to panic, but need to prepare
latvia.description: David M. Cattler is a Senior Fellow with the Transatlantic Defense and Security Program at the Center for European Policy Analysis (CEPA). He is a transatlantic security expert with more than 35 years of experience across the US government, NATO, and the Intelligence Community. During the recent Riga Conference event, he took time to speak with LSM's Anton Chernetskyi about a range of topical matters. The transcript of the conversation is reproduced below and you can watch a video of the interview above.

latvia.title: Latest list of Latvian companies doing business with Russia and Belarus published
latvia.description: On September 17th, an updated list of companies registered in Latvia that export goods to Russia or Belarus or import goods from these countries has been published on the website of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB).

latvia.title: Latvian Security Service launches case against terrorist threats
latvia.description: The State Security Service (VDD), in response to an ultimatum publicly issued by a pro-Kremlin group, launched criminal proceedings on 9 September this year regarding threats to carry out acts of terrorism against companies in Latvia that supply arms to Ukraine, the VDD reported.

latvia.title: Double diaspora events happening on Friday
latvia.description: On Friday, September 18th, 2026, two diaspora events will be held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs: the Latvian Diaspora Forum 2026 and the Diaspora Advisory Council meeting.

latvia.title: Ambassadors visit Latvia's eastern border region
latvia.description: Foreign ambassadors were the latest group to make the trip to Latvia's eastern border on September 16th, following on from recent outings for the President, Finance Minister and visiting diginataries.

latvia.title: Bus strike caused inconveniences to many Latvian residents
latvia.description: On Wednesday, 16 September, bus services across Latvia’s regions were considerably lighter than usual. Due to a protest by passenger transport operators, more than 3,000 journeys were cancelled, and the consequences were felt by those who use public transport to commute to work every day, as well as by schoolchildren, Latvian Television and Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Latvian PM says Baltics should 'speak as one' on Rail Baltica issue
latvia.description: The Baltic states must speak as one on the “Rail Baltica” issue, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) stated following a meeting with President Edgars Rinkēvičs on September 16.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 16th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: U.S. court ruling will allow airBaltic to receive 140 million euros
latvia.description: Latvian national airline airBaltic will immediately receive a first tranche of financing worth 140 million euros out of total planned financing of 350 million euros, in accordance with the decision of the Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York in the United States of America (US). airBaltic has attracted this financing from international investors.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia v Türkiye European Championship volleyball
latvia.description: Latvia plays Türkiye in an international volleyball match on September 16th. Watch live, courtesy of Latvian Television's coverage.

latvia.title: Ventspils can lay claim to being Latvia's bicycle capital
latvia.description: The country may be relatively flat and picturesque, but Latvia's bicycle infrastructure is often a bit of a disappointment to visitors from bike-friendly countries such as the Netherlands.

latvia.title: Union calls for Latvian Health Minister to quit
latvia.description: A month after Health Minister Hossam Abu Meri (New Unity) survived a no confidence vote in the Latvian parliament, a medics' union has called on him to quit.

latvia.title: President pardons inventor who warned CSDD about IT vulnerability
latvia.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs has pardoned inventor Raimonds Skuruls, who was recently convicted of extortion in connection with a security vulnerability discovered in the Road Traffic Safety Directorate's (CSDD) information technology (IT) system, presidential advisor Mārtiņš Drēģeris confirmed to the LETA newswire on Wednesday.

latvia.title: Saeima might be subjected to state audits in future
latvia.description: On Wednesday, the Saeima’s Public Administration and Local Government Committee backed the proposal to subject parliament to audits by the State Audit Office.

latvia.title: Pre-election debates see Latvian politicians making bold (but false) claims
latvia.description: As the 15th Saeima elections approach, debates between representatives of political forces are taking place virtually non-stop across various Latvian media outlets. "Re:Baltica"'s fact-checking project "Re:Check" investigated misleading statements made by politicians in them.

latvia.title: Namejs military drills taking place in and around Rīga
latvia.description: From 16 to 20 September, the active phase of the comprehensive national defence exercise ‘Namejs 2026’ will take place in Rīga and the surrounding area, according to the Rīga City Council.

latvia.title: Special awards for Italian pilots who shot down drone over Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 15, Latvian Minister of Defence Raivis Melnis welcomed Italian Minister of Defence Guido Crosetto on a working visit and the pair used the occasion to hand out medals to Italian fighter pilots who recently downed a drone over Latvian territory.

latvia.title: TESTS. Mēs uzminēsim tavu vecumu, balstoties uz to, kā tev veicas mīlas dzīvē
latvia.description: Saki, ko gribi, bet mūsu paradumi mūs nodod vienā mirklī, tāpēc, ilgi nedomājot, atbildi uz pāris vienkāršiem jautājumiem par savām pašreizējām vai iepriekšējām attiecībām, un mēs precīzi noteiksim tavu vecumu (vai vismaz to, cik vecs jūties)!

latvia.title: “Jā, nāksies ļoti ekonomiski skatīties pašiem uz saviem ledusskapjiem!” Auziņš paredz bargu ziemu visiem

latvia.description: Atrodoties politikā, saziņa starp politiķiem notiek ne tikai Saeimas sēžu zālē vai komisijā. Liela daļa ikdienas komunikācijas notiek arī dažādos čatos. latvia.title: Krāslavas novadā izsludināts brīdinājums par iespējamu apdraudējumu gaisa telpā
latvia.description: Latvijas armijas sociālo mediju kontos publicēts paziņojums par iespējamu gaisa telpas apdraudējumu Krāslavas novadā. “ESI GATAVS! Informējam, ka ir iespējams apdraudējums Latvijas gaisa telpā. Papildu rīcība šobrīd nav nepieciešama. Ja situācija mainīsies, saņemsi šūnu apraides paziņojumu par nepieciešamo rīcību,” teiks publikācijā. Gaisā ir pacelti NATO iznīcinātāji. Ir aktivizēti NATO Baltijas gaisa telpas patrulēšanas misijas iznīcinātāji. […]

latvia.description: Autors: Inga Patmalniece/Praktiskais Latvietis Kad ābeles tik dāsni aplaimo ar saviem gardajiem augļiem, tie jāliek lietā! Āboli iederas gan karstmaizītēs, gan saldos desertos. latvia.description: Latvijas Valsts prezidents Edgars Rinkēvičs pirmdien Ņujorkā informēja Apvienoto Nāciju Organizācijas (ANO) ģenerālsekretāru Antonio Guterrešu par Krievijas pretdarbību pret Baltijas un citām Ukrainu atbalstošām valstīm, kā rezultātā pieaug eskalācijas riski. latvia.title: Uzmanību, autovadītāji! Naktī daudzviet veidosies bieza migla
latvia.description: Pirmdienas vakarā un naktī uz otrdienu daudzviet Latvijā gaidāma migla, prognozē Latvijas Vides, ģeoloģijas un meteoroloģijas centrs. Migla izveidosies pirmdien no plkst. 20 līdz 23 un saglabāsies līdz rītam. Redzamība tajā būs 500-1000 metru. Sinoptiķi brīdina, ka atsevišķās vietās migla var būt ļoti bieza, ietekmējot āra aktivitātes un apgrūtinot transporta kustību.

latvia.title: Ukrainas dronu uzbrukuma laikā Krievija nav izsludinājusi trauksmi: maskaviešu drošība upurēta viena iemesla dēļ
latvia.description: Krievijas varasiestādes apzināti neinformēja Maskavas iedzīvotājus par dronu radītajiem draudiem, tādējādi, iespējams, pakļaujot viņu drošību riskam, lai netraucētu vēlēšanu norisi, ziņo “Dialog”. 20. septembrī notikušajā, kopš kara sākuma lielākā Ukrainas dronu uzbrukuma Maskavai laikā, Krievijas varasiestādes neieslēdza sirēnas un nenosūtīja iedzīvotājiem SMS brīdinājumus par draudiem. latvia.description: Daudzi no mums vismaz reizi mūžā, vērojot automātiskās mazgātuves birstes un spēcīgās ūdens strūklas no automašīnas salona, ir aizdomājušies – kā tas būtu, ja šim visam procesam izbrauktu cauri pats, bez aizsargājošā stikla un metāla? latvia.title: Jauns pavērsiens Krustkalnu traģēdijā, kurā gāja bojā divi bērni: policija pieņēmusi nepareizu lēmumu
latvia.description: Prokuratūra nolēmusi atjaunot kriminālprocesu par traģisko Krustkalnu ugunsgrēku, kurā gāja bojā divi bērni un cieta bērnu māte un vēl viens bērns, noskaidroja aģentūra LETA. Cietušās Dmitrijevu ģimenes aizstāvji no advokātu biroja “Landmesere un partneri” aģentūru LETA informēja, ka pirmdien saņemta atbilde no Ģenerālprokuratūras Krimināltiesiskā departamenta Pirmstiesas kriminālprocesa un tiesvedības koordinācijas nodaļas, ka prokurors, realizējot nākamā […]

lithuania.title: Beyond Ukraine : What to Know About Russia Escalating Confrontation With NATO
Beyond Ukraine : Why Europe is preparing for a wider conflict
I servizi segreti ceco e lettone : « Mosca pronta ad agire contro la Nato in mesi , non anni »
Finland’s Stubb warns Europe not to ‘overreact’ to Russian threats and sabotage
lithuania.description: Moscow isn’t seeking a full-scale war with NATO but instead trying to scare Europe into winding down its support for Ukraine, Finnish President tells POLITICO.

lithuania.title: Russia planning “accidental” strikes on eastern NATO states, warns Poland
lithuania.description: Russia wants to create a sense of "NATO's helplessness", said Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

lithuania.title: Trochę zimy pod koniec lata. Takie widoki przyniósł poniedziałek
lithuania.description: Początek tygodnia przyniósł w Polsce sporo opadów. Miejscami wystąpiły opady deszczu i drobnego gradu, co późnym latem nie jest niespodzianką. W górach natomiast zrobiło się zimowo.

lithuania.title: Evropské rozvědky varují před ruským testem článku pět. Babiš informaci od BIS nemá
lithuania.description: Vláda podle premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO) nemá od šéfa Bezpečnostní informační služby (BIS) Michala Koudelky informace o tom, že zemím NATO hrozí v řádu měsíců ruské útoky včetně možnosti invaze. Před ruským testem soudržnosti aliance otevřeně varovali členové evropských zpravodajských služeb v rozhovorech pro list The Guardian. Babiš popřel, že by Česku hrozilo bezprostřední nebezpečí.

lithuania.title: Slovenští politici se vymezují vůči Ficově zpochybňování článku pět NATO
lithuania.description: Slovenská politická scéna se vymezuje vůči výrokům tamního premiéra Roberta Fica (Smer) o závazcích vůči NATO, v nichž zpochybnil vojenskou pomoc partnerům v případě napadení. Před podobným postojem varovala slovenská hlava státu Peter Pellegrini i předseda tamního parlamentu Richard Raši (Hlas). Kritické vzkazy si Fico vyměnil i s českým prezidentem Petrem Pavlem.

lithuania.title: Armáda na Dnech NATO ukazuje protivzdušnou obranu či nový přepravní letoun
lithuania.description: Na letišti v Mošnově na Novojičínsku v sobotu začaly dvoudenní Dny NATO v Ostravě a Dny Vzdušných sil Armády ČR. Největší bezpečnostní přehlídku v Evropě navštívilo během soboty bezmála 92 tisíc lidí. Během zahájení promluvil prezident Petr Pavel, který prohlásil, že „jenom taková země, která bude vnímat svoji bezpečnost jako úkol všech, může být bezpečná a žít v míru“. Ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD) po boku premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO) upozornil, že bezpečnost není samozřejmost.

lithuania.title: Trump podepsal rozsáhlé protiruské sankce iniciované senátorem Grahamem
lithuania.description: Americký prezident Donad Trump v pátek podepsal zákon zavádějící rozsáhlé sankce, které mají dostat Rusko pod větší tlak a napomoci ukončení ruské války na Ukrajině. Sankční balík je odkazem republikánského senátora Lindseye Grahama, který zemřel v červenci krátce po své poslední návštěvě Ukrajiny, informovaly světové tiskové agentury.

lithuania.title: Stare de urgență în California înainte de El Nino. Furtuni violente și valuri uriașe ar putea lovi coasta
lithuania.description: Guvernatorul Californiei, Gavin Newsom, a declarat luni stare de urgență înainte de manifestarea fenomenului El Niño pe coasta de vest a SUA, în condițiile în care prognozele indică riscul unor furtuni violente, valuri uriașe și inundații.

lithuania.title: Premierul slovac, apropiat de Moscova, stârneşte controverse după ce a spus că nu va trimite trupe într-un război între NATO şi Rusia
lithuania.description: Premierul slovac Robert Fico a stârnit controverse după ce a spus că nu va trimite în niciun caz trupe în eventualitatea unui conflict armat direct între NATO şi Rusia, nici dacă vreun membru al Alianţei ar fi atacat şi s-ar invoca articolul 5 al tratatului NATO, şi a acuzat o retorică războinică în creştere în Europa care ar urmări să provoace un astfel de conflict, relatează luni agenţiile TASR, AFP şi EFE, citate de Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Procurorii au găsit acasă la Călin Georgescu un document fals care atestă că ar fi senator de Malta. Precizări oficiale
lithuania.description: În timpul perchezițiilor de luni de la domiciliul lui Călin Georgescu, procurorii DIICOT au găsit un document fals care atestă că fostul candidat la alegerile prezidențiale din 2024 este senator în Malta.

lithuania.title: Zeci de susținători ai lui Călin Georgescu, la sediul DIICOT. Garduri de protecție și jandarmi mobilizați în zonă
lithuania.description: Zeci de susținători ai lui Călin Georgescu s-au adunat luni în fața sediului DIICOT, unde fostul candidat la prezidențiale a ajuns în jurul orei 15.10 pentru audieri. Oamenii au scandat „Libertate”, „Călin nevinovat” și „Justiție, nu corupție”. Georgescu este vizat într-un dosar de constituire a unui grup infracțional organizat și înșelăciune. Autoritățile au montat garduri de protecție și au mobilizat mai multe echipaje de jandarmi în zonă.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu enumeră motivele pentru care AUR critică „guvernul UE”: „Nu se reduce la Ursula von der Leyen sau la Siegfried Mureșan”
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor Alianței pentru Unirea Românilor (AUR), a explicat, într-un mesaj publicat pe rețelele sociale, poziția partidului față de „guvernul UE” și a răspuns acuzațiilor conform cărora formațiunea ar fi „extremistă” și „anti-europeană”. Numărul doi din AUR a subliniat faptul că partidul nu-și dorește ca România să iasă din UE, ci vrea ca tratatele blocului comunitar să fie respectate.

lithuania.title: Șefii serviciilor secrete europene avertizează că Rusia plănuiește acțiuni mai decisive împotriva NATO: „O incursiune limitată”
lithuania.description: Reprezentanții serviciilor de informații europene au ridicat problema posibilității unui test iminent al Rusiei asupra NATO, unul dintre ei afirmând că un eventual atac ar putea avea loc în câteva „luni, nu ani”, relatează The Guardian.

lithuania.title: De ce munca de acasă ar putea fi mai dăunătoare pentru sănătate decât credem (studiu)
lithuania.description: În zilele în care angajații cu program hibrid rămân acasă în loc să meargă la birou, aceștia stau așezați cu aproximativ 44 de minute în plus și au cu aproximativ 58 de minute mai puțin de activitate ușoară și moderată până la intensă combinate, potrivit cercetării publicate în „International Journal of Behavioral Nutrition and Physical Activity”.

lithuania.title: Washingtonul depune eforturi pentru a găsi rachete Patriot disponibile pentru Ucraina, spune ambasadorul SUA la NATO
lithuania.description: Statele Unite colaborează activ cu aliații din NATO pentru a identifica rachetele Patriot disponibile care pot fi transferate sau vândute Ucrainei, a declarat Matthew Whitaker, reprezentantul permanent al SUA la NATO, într-un interviu acordat Radio Liberty, relatează Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: Ce ar putea declanșa activarea Articolului 5 al NATO? C. Diaconescu: „Decizia nu este rezervată doar atacurilor militare convenționale”
lithuania.description: În contextul în care Rusia își intensifică războiul hibrid în Europa, fostul ministru de Externe Cristian Diaconescu a subliniat, în exclusivitate la Digi24, că „situația este critică”, având în vedere faptul că state puternice „au ajuns să ia decizii care acum un an erau aproape de neconceput”. Cu titlu de exemplu în acest sens, fostul șef al diplomației române a enumerat Germania - în ceea ce privește mobilizarea și deschiderea unor spitale speciale în caz de criză, dar și Danemarca, cu referire la stagiul militar obligatoriu.

lithuania.title: Robert Fico susține că unii politicieni occidentali urmăresc să provoace un conflict NATO - Rusia: „Toarnă gaz pe foc”
lithuania.description: Unii politicieni occidentali urmăresc să provoace un conflict între NATO și Rusia, după ce strategia de a învinge Moscova în războiul cu Ucraina s-a dovedit a fi „un eșec”, a declarat sâmbătă prim-ministrul slovac Robert Fico, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Moscova a fost ţinta a sute de drone: cel puțin doi oameni au murit, iar o rafinărie a fost afectată
lithuania.description: Autorităţile ruse au declarat că Moscova şi regiunea sa au fost ţinta a sute de drone duminică dimineaţă, atac care a provocat moartea a cel puţin două persoane şi a avariat o rafinărie importantă, în ultima zi a alegerilor parlamentare. Guvernatorul regiunii din jurul capitalei, Andrei Vorobiov, a raportat că 249 de drone au fost doborâte, provocând pagube în mai multe zone rezidenţiale.

lithuania.title: NATO are trei planuri pentru apărarea flancului estic. Amiral: „În cazul unui atac al Rusiei, știm ce avem de făcut”
lithuania.description: NATO dispune de planuri de 4.000 de pagini pentru apărarea flancului estic, în cazul unei eventuale escaladări a conflictului cu Rusia, a declarat amiralul Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, președintele Comitetului Militar al Alianței, în marja reuniunii Comitetului Militar al NATO, potrivit portalului de știri din Letonia TVNET.

lithuania.title: Un băiat de 15 ani vrea să devină cel mai tânăr guvernator din SUA / În Vermont nu există limită de vârstă pentru candidatură / „Sincer, uită-te la cei care sunt la putere acum!”
lithuania.description: Un băiat de doar 15 ani și-a propus să devină cel mai tânăr guvernator din SUA. Candidatura sa este posibilă în statul Vermont datorită unei lacune legale ce nu stabilește o vârstă minimă pentru candidați, anunță Mediafax. Dean Roy este cea mai tânără persoană care a aspirat vreodată la un rol politic major în Statele […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: NATO general: Baltic states now much better defended than before
lithuania.description: Military security in the Baltic states has improved markedly since NATO developed a clear strategy and action plans, a senior NATO general said.

lithuania.title: NATO has 4,000-page plans for escalation on eastern flank
lithuania.description: NATO has 4,000-page plans in place in case the situation on its eastern flank escalates, NATO Military Committee chair Adm. Giuseppe Cavo Dragone said Saturday.

lithuania.title: Estonia and the U.S. seek rare‑earth agreement
lithuania.description: Estonia and the United States are working toward an agreement on rare earth elements to strengthen supply security. lithuania.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period

lithuania.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
lithuania.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.
